summary: Lupatapata is a rural territory of Kasai-Oriental bordering Mbuji-Mayi, made up of the Tshishimbi and Mukumbi sectors. No armed group is known to hold territory there; the Kamuina Nsapu insurgency of 2016-2017 was centred in Kasai-Central and Kasai and largely spared this area. State authority is exercised by the PNC (territorial and sub-commissariats) and local administration, with FARDC and ANR present in the provincial hinterland; insecurity consists of banditry, land/customary disputes and incidents at artisanal diamond sites. Peri-urban neighbourhoods attached to Mbuji-Mayi (Cibombo, Mulenda) are policed like the city. Live web research was unavailable in this run, so confidence is limited.
